orgDesign.companyProfile: Typical mid-size nutrition technology company with stream-aligned product squads and a small set of enabling platform teams. The organization is now modeled as a network of smaller teams sized around 10 FTE.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Customer-facing teams own formulation, operations, quality, and commercial workflows while shared teams provide data, platform, and governance capabilities. Larger value streams are split into sibling teams so accountability stays close to concrete capability ownership.
designPrinciples: Team boundaries follow customer workflows instead of internal systems.
Every value-stream team owns a visible slice of customer and business KPIs.
Platform, data, and governance are centralized only where scale and control benefit from standardization.
orgDesign.staffingPrinciple: Model total staffing around 250 FTE across delivery teams and group leadership; keep every delivery team at 6-10 FTE, with no individual team above 10 people.
orgDesign.groupingPrinciple: Use top-level groups for major value streams and a second layer of subgroups for team families when a stream contains multiple 10-FTE teams.
orgDesign.groupLeadershipPrinciple: Every group has explicit lightweight leadership: a Head of group, product and engineering directors, and principal/staff-plus IC coverage for architecture, product quality, and cross-team standards.
